sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.8 "EXTI falling trigger selection register 2 (EXTI_FTSR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 457.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Contains only register bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 FT39: Falling trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 39(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is disabled, FTx can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is enabled, FTx can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FTx is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Falling trigger disabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line
1: Falling trigger enabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line.
Bits 6:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 FT36: Falling trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 36(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is disabled, FTx can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is enabled, FTx can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FTx is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Falling trigger disabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line
1: Falling trigger enabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line.
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 2 FT34: Falling trigger event configuration bit of configurable event input 34(1)
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is disabled, FTx can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is enabled, FTx can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this FTx is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: Falling trigger disabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line
1: Falling trigger enabled (for event and Interrupt) for input line.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
1. The configurable event inputs are edge triggered, no glitch must be generated on these inputs.
If a falling edge on the configurable event input occurs during writing of the register, the associated pending bit is not set.
Rising and falling edge triggers can be set for the same configurable event input. In this case, both edges generate a
trigger.
